text:
alice: Kicking off preflight for router shift to v8.3. Plan: blue->green gradual by cohorts, latency gate at p95 <= 200ms, error rate <= 0.3%. Change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Canaries: 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100%, 10m steady per step. Pin fallback: router-v8.2.1.

deploy-bot: release started: rollout v8.3 -> router-pool. Track /rollouts/2187654321

brian: quick check -- is kv-cache warmup enabled for green? If not we should warm before 20%.

alice: yes, warmup flag true. warming pods: 3/3

observability-bot: metric alert cleared: infra-cpu normalized. No errors yet.

carol: test ingress latency on eu-west small load: p95=180ms, p50=60ms

dinesh: can we add a latency gate that pauses >200ms p95 for 10m? else auto-roll back.

alice: agree. set gate to p95>200ms sustained 10m => pause + notify ops then rollback threshold error_rate>0.5%

deploy-bot: ramping to 5% now

observability-bot: infra: p95=205ms in eu-west, increase coincides with green instances warming

brian: seeing transient spike on p95 from 150->210ms around pod 7 restart

carol: I think it's cache miss storm. confirming cache primed? still 20% miss rate

alice: pause ramp at 5%. do not proceed to 20% until miss rate <5% for 5m.

dinesh: I'm going to pin eu-west traffic back to v8.2.1 for region while we investigate. Command: `routerctl pin --region eu-west --version v8.2.1 --until 03:30UTC`

deploy-bot: pin command accepted. eu-west pinned to v8.2.1

eva: copying logs to #incidents and starting capture: `kubectl logs -n router --selector=role=green --tail=200`

carol: initial hypothesis: newer kernel param causing iowait. checking kernel, will try restart with the tuned config in staging.

alice: ops decision: keep global at 5% but ensure eu-west pinned. If error_rate >0.5% or p95 >220ms for 5m in any region -> rollback global to v8.2.1. We will update release notes and add a postmortem if rollback.

deploy-bot: rollout paused by alice. eu-west pinned. alerting on-call: @dinesh @carol

dinesh: I'm on it, will post root-cause once reprobed. For now leave canary at 5% but do not advance.

eva: added a short blameless note to the release channel and set a 30m review cadence.

alice: thanks. If we clear the cache-miss issue and p95 < 195ms for 10m, we'll retry ramp starting at 5% -> 20% with 15m hold.

deploy-bot: timelock set: review @ 30m

carol: deploying tuned kernel to green in staging now. will report in 12m.

brian: thumbs for rollback plan and pinned region. :thumbsup:

alice: closing loop: document the rollback commands here:

- rollback global: `deployctl rollback router --to v8.2.1 --scope global`
- unpin eu-west: `routerctl unpin --region eu-west`

alice: end.
